title: Joni Mitchell’s former Malibu home is listed for $27 million; its beachfront pool may be impossible to recreate today
summary_full: Joni Mitchell's former Malibu Colony home is listed for twenty-seven million dollars. This oceanfront property features a rare beachfront swimming pool and spa. The residence offers five bedrooms and five bathrooms with direct beach access. Its Cape Cod-inspired architecture maximizes natural light and ocean views. The home highlights Malibu's evolving luxury housing market and coastal regulations.
